_note: Real per-property facilities data, recovered from the hard-coded Promise.resolve payload inside bundles/frontend/theme_1/app/<page>.js. The live site's Angular controller sets $scope.features = groups[0].group, so ONLY tab 0 ('Amenities') is ever rendered; the remaining tabs are real CMS data for this property that the current site never shows. featureType 5/6 = boolean amenity; 1/2 = numeric value; 7 = enum id that cannot be resolved without the CMS lookup table.
